directions.name: Night Showing
directions.description: Full-bleed twilight exterior photography as the hero, headline in elegant variable-optical serif overlaid directly on the image. Generous whitespace, alternating full-width photo sections and text blocks, thin hairline dividers instead of cards. Warm ivory text against near-black navy. Testimonials get large pull-quote treatment.
directions.rationale: Twilight photography is one of the actual services offered, and it's the most cinematic thing Northvantage shoots — leading with it makes the hero itself proof of production quality. Classic navy carries a thread from the current branding so the redesign reads as an elevation, not a rebrand from zero.

directions.name: Vantage Point
directions.description: Split-screen hero: bold serif headline and dual CTA on the left, auto-scrolling portfolio grid on the right. Uppercase tracked eyebrow labels throughout. Modular card grid for services with rounded corners and pill-shaped CTA buttons; dramatic shadow elevation makes cards feel like physical prints stacked on a light table. Stat callout front and center.
directions.rationale: Plays directly on the Northvantage name while giving the grid/portfolio structure a literal reason to exist — the studio-craft direction for agents who want proof of volume and consistency before they call.

contrast_axes.typography: uppercase tracked labels + one dominant headline size

directions.name: Blue Hour
directions.description: Full-bleed cinematic video loop hero (muted, autoplay) with one massive headline word in extreme size contrast against tiny supporting text — thin-weight serif paired with a black-weight accent word. No card shadows; depth comes from soft amber glow blurs instead. Asymmetric section rhythm, portfolio-grid proof with a single-line testimonial marquee instead of quote blocks.
directions.rationale: The boldest, most editorial-studio direction — looks the least like a real-estate-marketing-company and the most like a premium production house, matching the explicit 'not corporate/stock-photo' reposition.

contrast_axes.typography: extreme size contrast, one dominant headline word
contrast_axes.whitespace: generous in hero, tight in body
